cards.text: Past continuous: was/were + -ing. Dipakai untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung pada waktu tertentu di masa lalu (sudah mulai, belum selesai).

examples.en: At 8 o'clock last night I was watching TV.
examples.id: Jam 8 tadi malam saya sedang menonton TV.

examples.en: They were waiting for the bus.

cards.text: Kejadian singkat (past simple) sering terjadi di tengah kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung (past continuous).

examples.en: The phone rang while I was cooking.
examples.id: Telepon berdering ketika saya sedang memasak.

examples.en: It was raining when we left.
examples.id: Hujan sedang turun ketika kami berangkat.

cards.text: Jika kejadian terjadi berurutan, semuanya memakai past simple. Bandingkan:

examples.en: When Sari arrived, we had dinner.
examples.id: Sari datang, lalu kami makan malam.

examples.en: When Sari arrived, we were having dinner.
examples.id: Kami sudah mulai makan ketika Sari datang.

cards.trap: Kata kerja keadaan (know, want, dll.) tetap tidak memakai -ing: We knew each other, bukan we were knowing.

questions.prompt: I ___ my finger while I was cutting vegetables.
questions.why: Jari teriris adalah kejadian singkat di tengah kegiatan, jadi past simple (cut). Kegiatan yang berlangsung memakai was cutting.

questions.prompt: It ___ (rain) when we left the house, so we took an umbrella.
questions.why: Hujan sedang berlangsung ketika kami berangkat, jadi past continuous.

questions.prompt: Susun kalimat: "Rina sedang menunggu saya ketika saya tiba."
questions.answer: Rina was waiting for me when I arrived.
accept: When I arrived, Rina was waiting for me.
questions.why: Kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung memakai was waiting; kejadian singkat memakai past simple (arrived).

questions.prompt: We ___ walking home when we saw the accident.
questions.why: Kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa lalu, subjek we, jadi were + -ing.

questions.prompt: I was knowing the answer, but I didn't say anything.
questions.answer: I knew the answer, but I didn't say anything.
questions.why: know adalah kata kerja keadaan, jadi tidak memakai -ing.

pairs: because they were talking to a friend.
because I was chatting on my phone.
while he was riding too fast.
questions.why: Bagian kanan memakai past continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung saat kejadian utama terjadi.

questions.prompt: When Tom arrived, we ___ (have) dinner, so we asked him to join us.
questions.why: Kami sudah mulai makan sebelum Tom datang, jadi past continuous.

questions.source: Saya sedang tidur ketika kamu menelepon.
questions.answer: I was sleeping when you called
accept: I was sleeping when you phoned
I was sleeping when you rang
When you called, I was sleeping
When you phoned, I was sleeping
When you rang, I was sleeping
I was asleep when you called
I was asleep when you phoned
I was asleep when you rang
questions.why: Kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung memakai was sleeping; teleponnya kejadian singkat (past simple).

questions.prompt: When the film ended, we ___ home.
questions.why: Filmnya selesai, lalu kami pulang. Kejadian berurutan memakai past simple.

questions.prompt: Rani was living in Medan when I met her.
questions.answer: Rani was living in Medan when I met her.
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: tinggal di Medan sedang berlangsung ketika kejadian bertemu terjadi.
